Collect all batch correction plots for advanced_plots = TRUE

Source: R/batchCorrectR_Utils.R
bc_collect_plots.Rd

Builds the named list of plots written to <project_dir>/all/figures/batch_corrector/ when batchCorrectR(advanced_plots = TRUE). Combines the existing before/after ggplots (bc_plot_correction_results()) with the GUI-only figures (signal drift, RSD-by-class, per-metabolite RSD).

Usage

bc_collect_plots(result, original_data, qc_label = "qc")

Arguments

result

A batchCorrectR() result list.

original_data

Data frame passed as data to batchCorrectR().

qc_label

Character. QC label used during correction.

Value

Named list; each entry is list(static, interactive) and the names become the saved-file basenames.
